name: mc_light
title: Light and spawn check
description:
Finds the dark spaces in a box where hostile mobs can spawn, and can suggest where to put lights so none are left. Read-only.

WHEN TO USE: after building an interior, cave, basement, wall walk or courtyard, to answer "can mobs spawn in here?" and to get a ready-made list of light positions (invisible light blocks by default) to pass to mc_build `cells`. Run it again after building the lights to confirm 0 dark spaces.

WHEN NOT TO USE: for how a build looks (use mc_render) or whether a player can walk somewhere (use mc_walk). It does not model mob-specific rules (biomes, slime chunks, structures, spawner blocks, mob size), and it is not a lighting design tool for appearance.

PARAMETERS: `from`/`to` are inclusive [x,y,z] corners of the box to check; volume at most limits.max-read-volume (200,000 by default). A spawn space is a cell whose feet and head cells are open (air, plants, 1-layer snow; not carpet, water, rails, buttons, pressure plates or redstone parts) above a floor with a full solid top (top or double slabs and upside-down stairs count; glass, leaves, ice, magma, bottom slabs, right-side-up stairs, fences and walls do not); `spawnable: false` instead counts every open cell. A space is dark when its block light is at most `threshold` (0-14, default 0, the modern hostile-mob rule); sky light is ignored (night) unless `includeSky: true`, which also requires sky light at most threshold. `samples` (0-200, default 20) lists dark feet cells. `suggest` (optional) asks for a greedy light plan: `block` (default "light", the invisible light block; any light-emitting block id works), `level` (1-15, default 11, above threshold; for the light block it sets its level, for other blocks give the level that block emits), `spacing` (1-32, default 1: minimum distance between suggested lights, larger for even spread), `placement` "hidden" (default for light: inside the dark spaces themselves, invisible and not in the way of walking because light blocks have no collision), "floor" (on the floor in a dark space) or "ceiling" (the open cell just under a ceiling above a dark space, up to 16 blocks up).

SIDE EFFECTS: none - read-only. Chunks in the box are loaded and copied a few per tick; the analysis runs off the main thread. Light coverage is estimated by spreading light inside the box only, and the server updates light a moment after blocks change, so build, wait a few seconds, then re-check.

to.description: Inclusive corner [x, y, z] opposite from.

world.description: World name. Omitted uses the plugin's configured default world.

threshold.description: A space is dark when its light is at most this (0-14). Default 0.

includeSky.description: Also require sky light <= threshold (dark even by day). Default false: sky light ignored.

spawnable.description: true (default): only spaces a mob can spawn in; false: every open cell.

suggest.description: Ask for a greedy list of light positions in mc_build cells form.

level.description: Light level the block emits. Default 11.

spacing.description: Minimum distance between lights (largest axis difference). Default 1.

placement.description: hidden (light block only, default), floor or ceiling.
